note: Section 2 (techniques & abilities) of the Angel cluster. Q051 is the closed roster of Angel's named cursed techniques, staged in _jjk_page_angel.decl2.yaml (G6); the 46 fact questions cover the Cursed Technique sub-section (Technique Extinguishment, Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder), the non-technique abilities under Abilities and Powers (Overall Abilities, Flight, Great Intellect, Incarnation), the Trivia etymology beats, and the technique-in-combat beats drawn from the Culling Game Arc and Shinjuku Showdown Arc. Golds are NFKD-verbatim on the Angel page and present in the live bundle; the kanji/romaji name cells and unstated details are retired with reasons.

retired.question: What is the kanji for the Technique Extinguishment?
retired.reason: Unchunked: the kanji (術式が消滅) live only in the Nihongo/Ruby cell of the Cursed Technique section's technique-name cell, which the pipeline does not make goldable.

retired.question: What is the romaji of Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder?
retired.reason: Unchunked: the romaji (Shutsuryoku Saidai: Yakobu no Hashigo) lives only in the Nihongo/Ruby cell of the Cursed Technique section's technique-name cell, which the pipeline does not make goldable.

retired.question: What is the Angel's Domain Expansion?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: the Angel page assigns her no domain; domains appear only as her knowledge (Domain Amplification, domain clashes, id 073) and as other characters' domains in the fight prose.

retired.question: What is the cost of using the Technique Extinguishment?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: no energy cost or usage limit is quantified; the only limit the page states is that it is nearly impossible to split incarnated sorcerers from their hosts without killing both (id 057).

retired.question: What grade or rank is the Angel as a sorcerer?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: her grade is never given; 'special grades' on the page refers to the cursed objects susceptible to her technique (like the Prison Realm, id 056), not to her own rank.
